'''Kombat''' is a one-day 2on2 tournament played '''Sunday 22nd August''', start 21:00 {{Abbr/CEST}}. The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. 

Streamed by [https://www.twitch.tv/videos/1040458874 SuddendeathTV] on Twitch.

=== Format ===
* Max 16 teams single elimination bracket.
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}

== Rules ==
* Map order: cmd rnd for first pick. then p2 pick. p1 toss, p2 toss, remaining map as decider.
* No walkovers will be given until 21:30
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.gg/R6nkeCjvEB discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|alice|flag=se}}
